description: The plot illustrates how “Reliability Score” varies with “Cost” for three approaches (3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4). The x-axis is labeled “Cost,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 10 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 (no units shown). The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 30 to 90 with tick labels at 30, 50, 70, and 90. The 3-Model Ensemble is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 83 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 75 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is shown as a red solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 85 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 73 at cost 10. GPT-4 is shown as a yellow/gold solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 89 at cost 0 to about 65 at cost 5 and about 41 at cost 10.
